mentions.description: A curriculum-building and team-training SaaS for learning, currently in Alpha with a tester group. It grew out of the builder's personal research, with plans to eventually open source the product and work on federation support.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an Alpha with a tester group for a learning product.  A personal research extended to curriculum building and team training SaaS. I'd like to open source it and work on federation but those don't pay the bills yet.
